note: Both sets capture the core Energy Balance thresholds (full points ≥ 0 kWh, reduced −50 to 0 kWh, no points ≤ −50 kWh) and the movie-night scoring and visit rules, and both make the same misreading of the figure's y-axis tick '20' as a maximum of 20 points.
